task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: The FRONT_CRATE is between the CAR and the MEDICINE_BOTTLE, acting as an obstacle. The plan is: 1) Navigate to the FRONT_CRATE, 2) Pick it up, 3) Navigate to the TEMP_ZONE and place it there to clear the path, 4) Navigate to the MEDICINE_BOTTLE, 5) Pick it up, 6) Navigate to the MEDICAL_TABLE, 7) Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on the MEDICAL_TABLE.
assumptions: FRONT_CRATE is the obstacle in front of the CAR that needs to be removed
TEMP_ZONE is a suitable temporary location to place the FRONT_CRATE
The robot CAR can interact with objects within 2.0 Euclidean distance
Navigation tolerance of 0.5 is sufficient to get within interaction distance
